acceptanceCriteria.text: Raid countdown displays total power when data is available.
Recent raid result preserves and displays the same total power.

checkpointPayload.description: Display raid power for active countdowns and recent results using available rally and roster data.
checkpointPayload.implementationPlan: 1. Confirm power semantics and available fields in captured rally data. 2. Persist power with rally march and result history. 3. Render the value in raid countdown and result rows. 4. Run targeted regression tests and build.
checkpointPayload.title: Show raid total power in result and countdown

taskChanges.newValue: User clarified total power means all raid participants. Captured getRallyById squads contain hero IDs/levels/stars and troop counts, but no member or squad power. Captured mobRallyAttackResult and getPage rallyMobAttackResult reports also have no power. User will provide a log/API with per-member power. Removed provisional own-team implementation; code unchanged. Waiting for the source payload to map exact fields before implementation.
